firm.name: Law Offices of Shannon Ellmers, PLLC

about: Shannon Ellmers is a skilled litigator and negotiator who maintains a practice in family law with an emphasis on marital dissolutions that involve complex financial and property issues. Shannon provides exceptional representation to family law clients in every setting, whether direct negotiation, formal dispute resolution, or trial. Shannon often represents business owners, entrepreneurs, physicians, trust beneficiaries, attorneys, and corporate officers. ​ Shannon’s approach is one of well-reasoned scale, determined by the needs of the client and the applicable legal principles, and often involves working with outside experts to develop sound, defensible legal approaches. Shannon is a frequent speaker at CLE attorney seminars on family law topics. ​ Shannon is a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, an organization limited to members who have extensive legal knowledge and experience in the area of family law.

Shannon works diligently with each client to identify their goals, which ultimately shape and drive the strategy of their representation. Shannon frames the client's goals within the context of applicable legal principles in order to educate the client as to the full range of legal options and strategies available. This education and goal-based approach serves clients well by giving them the opportunity to be active and engaged decision makers.
